skills.name: Code Reviewer
skills.description: Choose to review any code change for quality, maintainability and bugs, in any language. Not for Python-only style, database work or security-only audits.

skills.name: Python Reviewer
skills.description: Choose to review Python code for PEP 8, idioms, type hints and Python-specific bugs. Not for other languages.

skills.name: Security Reviewer
skills.description: Choose to look for vulnerabilities: secrets, injection, unsafe input handling, OWASP Top 10. Not for style or general quality review.

skills.name: Database Reviewer
skills.description: Choose for PostgreSQL schemas, SQL queries, migrations or database performance. Not for application logic without a database.

skills.name: Build Error Resolver
skills.description: Choose when a TypeScript or build error is failing and needs the smallest fix to turn the build green. Not for new features or refactors.

skills.name: E2E Test Runner
skills.description: Choose to create or run end-to-end browser tests of user journeys. Not for unit tests or non-browser work.

skills.name: Test-Driven Development Guide
skills.description: Choose when building new behavior or fixing a bug test-first with high coverage. Not for writing a plan or design, and not for end-to-end browser tests.

skills.name: Documentation Updater
skills.description: Choose to update READMEs, guides or codemaps so documentation matches the code. Not for changing program behavior.

skills.name: Refactor Cleaner
skills.description: Choose to remove dead code, unused dependencies and duplication without changing behavior. Not for adding features.

skills.name: Software Architect
skills.description: Choose when designing or planning structure, approach or trade-offs for new work, including writing a plan. Not for small edits or routine fixes.
